correctionNotes: Open earbud with no seal: sub-bass rolls off steeply (about -9 dB at 60 Hz and -13 dB at 40 Hz vs mids on the community graph). Support bass with a moderate low shelf plus a mid-bass bell; do not chase sealed-IEM sub-bass levels.

Requested tuning direction is a Harman-style target with appropriately enhanced bass: keep total low-end lift around +3 to +4 dB centered on 60-120 Hz so the open fit keeps its fast, clean character instead of forcing rumble.
Mids measure smooth and reviews praise natural vocals; leave 300 Hz-3 kHz essentially intact, with only a small ~280 Hz trim so the bass boost does not bleed into the low mids.
Treble falls early above ~6 kHz and sparkle is slightly subdued; a gentle 10 kHz high shelf restores some air, but avoid large upper-treble boosts because coupler behavior up there is unreliable.
Do not chase the mild 5-6.5 kHz secondary resonance or >8 kHz graph detail with narrow EQ; this is a single-unit informal measurement, so treat fine structure as approximate.
signature: Open titanium flathead earbud with smooth natural mids, fast mid-bass but rolled-off sub-bass, and relaxed detailed treble with slightly subdued sparkle; community measurement shows bass rolling off below ~150 Hz and treble falling early above ~6 kHz.
